Combined donor + recipient (pro forma) series

Source: R/outcomes.R
merger_proforma.Rd

Before a merger the recipient's own books exclude the donor, so comparing the recipient before and after mixes the merger's effect with the mechanical jump from absorbing the donor (and, in a rescue, the donor's weak ratios). The pro forma series sums the recipient and its donor(s) in each pre-merger year, on each organization's own fiscal calendar, and uses the recipient alone from pre_max + 1 on. Ratios are recomputed from the summed amounts.

Usage

merger_proforma(
  fp,
  level = c("merger", "group"),
  pre_max = -1L,
  require_all = TRUE
)

Arguments

fp

Output of merger_fiscal_panel().

level

"merger" (one recipient and one donor per series) or "group" (all donors in a MERGER_GROUP_ID, aligned on each donor's own time from merger, with the recipient's years from the group's first merger).

pre_max

Last event year summed (default -1: the donor's final year, 0, is often a partial year).

require_all

When TRUE, pre-merger years in which any donor has no return are set to NA.

Value

A data.table with ROLE = "combined", the ID column (MERGER_ID or MERGER_GROUP_ID), EIN2 and TAX_YEAR of the recipient, TIME_FROM_MERGER, the summed measures, recomputed ratios, N_DONORS, N_DONORS_OBS, PF_EZ_MEMBERS, and PF_COMPLETE.

Details

Amounts a 990-EZ donor does not report (functional expenses, employees, revenue breakdown) count as zero, and PF_EZ_MEMBERS counts those donors. REVENUE_HHI is NA in years with an EZ member. 'fiscal' ratio columns are not carried over: compute them from the summed amounts if needed.
